decision.reason: [ev-924a17cf8cd5] only lists "You're running Crossplane v1.20" as a prerequisite for upgrading. Neither it nor the rest of the Prerequisites section [ev-dac056af4ac4, ev-8e78387c2b06, ev-13abab392283] says what happens if you upgrade from another version. Nothing says the upgrade or install fails, is gated or is refused. That means "upgrade-blocked", which claims a failure, isn't supported. The proposed wording "v1.20 or later" also goes beyond the text. To decide this, we'd need upstream text that says whether upgrading to v2.0.0 from a version other than v1.20 fails (a version gate or failing hook) or is only unsupported, or that names a required step-by-step upgrade path.
